package audio

// ddsonic's base-compatible mechanism probes (design S18, for S2, S5, S7 and
// S13). Each runs the real access point and key provider against the
// synthetic access point, in both stages. They name nothing patch 0002
// adds, so they compile against the unpatched v0.9.1 base too, where each
// must fail on its behavioural assertion, marked Sn-BASE-RED. Against the
// active tree they must pass. A failure without a marker is a failed
// precondition or a defect, never base red evidence.
//
// What they observe: what the peer receives (writes), whether and when a
// caller returns, goroutine stacks, the access point's subscriptions
// (ap.DDSonicSubscribers), and, for S7 only, whether an answer found no
// live request (bpUnknownAnswers, a per-stage adapter: see
// audio_probe_adapter_*.go.txt for what each stage can observe and how).

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"errors"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
	"github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot/ap"
)

const bpLimit = 10 * time.Second

var bpKey = []byte("0123456789abcdef")

// bpLogger counts the stock provider's "invalid sequence" warnings; it
// discards everything else.
type bpLogger struct {
	librespot.NullLogger
	invalidSeq atomic.Uint64
}

func (l *bpLogger) Warnf(format string, _ ...interface{}) {
	if strings.Contains(format, "invalid sequence") {
		l.invalidSeq.Add(1)
	}
}
func (l *bpLogger) WithField(string, interface{}) librespot.Logger { return l }
func (l *bpLogger) WithError(error) librespot.Logger               { return l }

func bpAP(t *testing.T) (*ap.DDSonicFakeAP, *ap.Accesspoint, *ap.DDSonicFakeConn) {
	t.Helper()
	f, err := ap.DDSonicContractFakeAP()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(f.Close)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), bpLimit)
	defer cancel()
	a, err := f.Connect(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("PRECONDITION: connecting to the synthetic access point: %v", err)
	}
	// R70-1: the probe owns a from here, on every path. Its cleanup runs
	// after the probe's own later ones (its gates' releases) and before the
	// fake's: a's Close is joined while the fake is still up, then nothing
	// of the SDK's loops may be left for the next test.
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if closeJoined(t, "cleanup", a) {
			bpQuiet(t, "after the probe's access point was closed")
		}
	})
	c := f.Next(bpLimit)
	if c == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the synthetic access point saw no login")
	}
	return f, a, c
}

// contractStacks is every goroutine's stack, its buffer grown until nothing
// is cut off. It is the failure-only diagnostic of the process-wide checks
// (R70-1): what each failure prints, never what decides it.
func contractStacks() string {
	for n := 1 << 20; ; n *= 2 {
		buf := make([]byte, n)
		if m := runtime.Stack(buf, true); m < n {
			return string(buf[:m])
		}
	}
}

// closeJoined closes a, an access point the test owns, and waits within
// bpLimit for Close to return (R70-1). A Close begun during a reconnect waits
// for that reconnect, so it is called while the synthetic access point is
// still up, where the reconnect can end. Close is idempotent: a Close the
// test began itself is joined here too. A timeout fails the test, with every
// goroutine's stack.
func closeJoined(t *testing.T, what string, a *ap.Accesspoint) bool {
	t.Helper()
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() { a.Close(); close(done) }()
	select {
	case <-done:
		return true
	case <-time.After(bpLimit):
		t.Errorf("%s: the access point's Close did not return within %v\ngoroutines at the failure:\n%s", what, bpLimit, contractStacks())
		return false
	}
}

// bpLoops counts the goroutines inside an access point's receive loop or
// pong ticker, or inside a key provider method: names the base and the
// active tree share.
func bpLoops() int {
	n := 0
	for _, g := range strings.Split(contractStacks(), "\n\n") {
		if strings.Contains(g, "ap.(*Accesspoint).recvLoop(") || strings.Contains(g, "ap.(*Accesspoint).pongAckTicker(") || strings.Contains(g, "audio.(*KeyProvider).") {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// bpQuiet waits within bpLimit for bpLoops to be 0: a probe's access point,
// closed, has left nothing running (R70-1). A timeout fails the test, with
// every goroutine's stack; it is an Errorf so the fake's cleanup still runs.
func bpQuiet(t *testing.T, what string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(bpLimit)
	for {
		n := bpLoops()
		if n == 0 {
			return
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Errorf("%s: %d access point loop or key provider goroutines are running, want 0\ngoroutines at the failure:\n%s", what, n, contractStacks())
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

type bpResult struct {
	key []byte
	err error
}

func bpRequest(ctx context.Context, p *KeyProvider) <-chan bpResult {
	out := make(chan bpResult, 1)
	go func() {
		key, err := p.Request(ctx, make([]byte, 16), make([]byte, 20))
		out <- bpResult{key, err}
	}()
	return out
}

// bpAwait waits up to d for a result.
func bpAwait(out <-chan bpResult, d time.Duration) (bpResult, bool) {
	select {
	case r := <-out:
		return r, true
	case <-time.After(d):
		return bpResult{}, false
	}
}

func bpUntil(t *testing.T, what string, cond func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(bpLimit)
	for !cond() {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: not within %v", what, bpLimit)
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// bpWithin reports whether cond holds within d.
func bpWithin(d time.Duration, cond func() bool) bool {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(d)
	for !cond() {
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return false
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
	return true
}

// bpStacks counts the goroutines whose stacks hold every one of parts.
func bpStacks(parts ...string) int {
	buf := make([]byte, 8<<20)
	n := 0
	for _, g := range strings.Split(string(buf[:runtime.Stack(buf, true)]), "\n\n") {
		all := true
		for _, part := range parts {
			all = all && strings.Contains(g, part)
		}
		if all {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

func bpAnswer(c *ap.DDSonicFakeConn, seq uint32) error {
	return c.Send(ap.PacketTypeAesKey, append(binary.BigEndian.AppendUint32(nil, seq), bpKey...))
}

// S2: a request written on a connection that is then replaced, with the
// reconnect completed and its caller's context live, ends at once with an
// error of its own (not its context's, not the window's, not the access
// point's closing), and is not sent again. Stock v0.9.1 leaves it pending
// until its 15-second window.
func TestDDSonicContractProbeS2InFlightAcrossReconnect(t *testing.T) {
	f, a, c1 := bpAP(t)
	a.Receive() // serviced, so the peer's close is seen
	p := NewAudioKeyProvider(&bpLogger{}, a)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	out := bpRequest(ctx, p)
	if _, ok := c1.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, bpLimit); !ok {
		t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the request was not written on the first connection")
	}
	before := &a.StoredCredentials()[0]
	if err := c1.PeerClose(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c2 := f.Next(bpLimit)
	if c2 == nil {
		t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the access point did not reconnect")
	}
	bpUntil(t, "PRECONDITION: the reconnect completed on the client", func() bool { return &a.StoredCredentials()[0] != before })
	r, ended := bpAwait(out, 5*time.Second)
	if !ended {
		t.Errorf("S2-BASE-RED: the in-flight request was still pending 5s after its connection was replaced and the reconnect completed")
	} else if r.err == nil || errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(r.err, context.DeadlineExceeded) || errors.Is(r.err, ap.ErrAccesspointClosed) {
		t.Errorf("S2-BASE-RED: the in-flight request ended with %v, not with its connection's replacement", r.err)
	}
	if _, ok := c2.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, 500*time.Millisecond); ok {
		t.Errorf("S2-BASE-RED: the in-flight request was sent again on the new connection")
	}
	if !ended {
		cancel()
		bpAwait(out, 20*time.Second)
	}
}

// S5: a request whose context ended before the call writes nothing and
// launches nothing: neither with the key service idle (stock v0.9.1 hands
// it over, registers the service with the access point and writes it), nor
// with the service busy in a held write (stock v0.9.1 waits for the
// service, whatever the context, and then writes it).
func TestDDSonicContractProbeS5RefusedEntryWritesNothing(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("idle", func(t *testing.T) {
		_, a, c := bpAP(t)
		p := NewAudioKeyProvider(&bpLogger{}, a)
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancel()
		r, ok := bpAwait(bpRequest(ctx, p), bpLimit)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("the request with an ended context did not return")
		}
		if !errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Errorf("the request with an ended context = %v, want context.Canceled", r.err)
		}
		if _, ok := c.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, time.Second); ok {
			t.Errorf("S5-BASE-RED: a request whose context had ended before the call was written")
		}
		if n := ap.DDSonicSubscribers(a, ap.PacketTypeAesKey); n != 0 {
			t.Errorf("S5-BASE-RED: a request whose context had ended before the call launched the key service (%d subscriptions)", n)
		}
	})
	t.Run("busy", func(t *testing.T) {
		_, a, c := bpAP(t)
		gate := ap.DDSonicContractGateWrites(a)
		t.Cleanup(gate.Release)
		p := NewAudioKeyProvider(&bpLogger{}, a)
		entered := gate.Arm()
		ctx1, cancel1 := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		defer cancel1()
		first := bpRequest(ctx1, p)
		select {
		case <-entered:
		case <-time.After(bpLimit):
			t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the first request's write was not held")
		}
		ctx2, cancel2 := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancel2()
		second := bpRequest(ctx2, p)
		r, returned := bpAwait(second, 2*time.Second)
		if !returned {
			t.Errorf("S5-BASE-RED: a request whose context had already ended did not return while the key service was busy")
		} else if !errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Errorf("the request with an ended context = %v, want context.Canceled", r.err)
		}
		gate.Release()
		if _, ok := c.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, bpLimit); !ok {
			t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the first request was not written once released")
		}
		if _, ok := c.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, time.Second); ok {
			t.Errorf("S5-BASE-RED: the request whose context had ended was written once the service was free")
		}
		cancel1()
		bpAwait(first, 20*time.Second)
		if !returned {
			bpAwait(second, 20*time.Second)
		}
	})
}

// S7: a request cancelled while its write is held (the write holds the
// connection's send lock) returns promptly, and its logical record is gone
// while the physical write is still held: an answer for it then finds no
// live request, and so does a second answer after the write completes.
// Stock v0.9.1 returns promptly too, but keeps the record (its pump cannot
// even take the answer until the write returns, and then hands it to the
// cancelled request).
func TestDDSonicContractProbeS7CancelDuringHeldWrite(t *testing.T) {
	_, a, c := bpAP(t)
	gate := ap.DDSonicContractGateWrites(a)
	t.Cleanup(gate.Release)
	log := &bpLogger{}
	p := NewAudioKeyProvider(log, a)
	entered := gate.Arm()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	out := bpRequest(ctx, p)
	select {
	case <-entered:
	case <-time.After(bpLimit):
		t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the request's write was not held")
	}
	cancel()
	if r, ok := bpAwait(out, 2*time.Second); !ok || !errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) {
		t.Fatalf("the cancelled request did not return promptly with its cancellation (returned %t, %v)", ok, r.err)
	}
	if err := bpAnswer(c, 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bpWithin(2*time.Second, func() bool { return bpUnknownAnswers(p, log) == 1 }) {
		t.Errorf("S7-BASE-RED: while the cancelled request's write was held, an answer for it did not find its record gone")
	}
	gate.Release()
	if _, ok := c.Wait(ap.PacketTypeRequestKey, bpLimit); !ok {
		t.Fatal("PRECONDITION: the held write did not complete once released")
	}
	if err := bpAnswer(c, 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bpWithin(2*time.Second, func() bool { return bpUnknownAnswers(p, log) == 2 }) {
		t.Errorf("S7-BASE-RED: after the held write completed, the two answers did not both find no record (%d did): the cancelled request's record outlived its cancellation", bpUnknownAnswers(p, log))
	}
}

// S13: with a reconnect holding the connection lock before the key
// service's first subscription, callers of an already constructed provider
// that cancel return at once, while that subscription is still held. Stock
// v0.9.1's callers cannot hand their requests to the service, whatever
// their contexts, until the subscription completes.
func TestDDSonicContractProbeS13FirstRegistrationHeld(t *testing.T) {
	f, a, c1 := bpAP(t)
	a.Receive() // serviced, so the peer's close starts a reconnect
	p := NewAudioKeyProvider(&bpLogger{}, a)
	hold := f.Hold()
	t.Cleanup(hold)
	if err := c1.PeerClose(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bpUntil(t, "PRECONDITION: a reconnect holding the connection lock", func() bool {
		return bpStacks("ap.(*Accesspoint).reconnect(") > 0
	})
	const n = 4
	var cancels []context.CancelFunc
	var outs []<-chan bpResult
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		cancels = append(cancels, cancel)
		outs = append(outs, bpRequest(ctx, p))
	}
	held := func() bool {
		return bpStacks("audio.(*KeyProvider).", "ap.(*Accesspoint).Receive(", "sync.(*RWMutex).RLock(") > 0
	}
	bpUntil(t, "PRECONDITION: the key service's first subscription waiting for the connection lock", held)
	bpUntil(t, "PRECONDITION: every caller inside Request", func() bool {
		return bpStacks("audio.(*KeyProvider).Request(") >= n
	})
	if s := ap.DDSonicSubscribers(a, ap.PacketTypeAesKey); s != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("PRECONDITION: the key service registered (%d subscriptions) though its subscription should be held", s)
	}
	for _, cancel := range cancels {
		cancel()
	}
	var pending []<-chan bpResult
	for i, out := range outs {
		if r, ok := bpAwait(out, 3*time.Second); !ok {
			t.Errorf("S13-BASE-RED: caller %d did not return after its cancellation while the first subscription was held", i)
			pending = append(pending, out)
		} else if !errors.Is(r.err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Errorf("caller %d = %v, want context.Canceled", i, r.err)
		}
	}
	if !held() {
		t.Error("the first subscription was no longer held when the callers were checked")
	}
	hold()
	// The held reconnect completes and the key service registers before
	// the probe returns, so no reconnect of this access point is left
	// running, against a closed fake, after it.
	bpUntil(t, "the reconnect completed and the key service registered", func() bool {
		return ap.DDSonicSubscribers(a, ap.PacketTypeAesKey) > 0
	})
	for _, out := range pending {
		bpAwait(out, 20*time.Second)
	}
}
